data.title: 1H 2021 Transparency Report Statistics
data.content:
There were a total of 273 government requests for the communication data of Daum and Kakao services. This is not significantly different from the second half of 2020 (184 requests). Since the first half of 2013, Kakao has not provided communication data.
In response to requests for data on the communication-restricting measures of Daum services, only data that strictly pertain to standards are provided after thorough review conducted in accordance to relevant legislation. In the case of Kakao’s services, we do not provide any data on communication-restricting measures.
The number of requests for communication data related to Daum services has decreased by 10.1% and the number of accounts processed has decreased by 8.1% since the second half of 2020. In the case of Kakao’s services, the numbers of requests and accounts processed have both increased by 5.6% and 4.5% respectively, since the second half of 2020.
Requests based on search and seizure warrants for Daum services have increased by 16.1%, while those for Kakao have decreased by 8.3% since the second half of 2020. Kakao strives to provide only the minimum necessary information to meet the requirements.
Meanwhile, the number of accounts processed in response to requests based on search and seizure warrants for Kakao services has increased by 86.8%, since the second half of 2020. The increase is due to a request related to a specific case of law violation. Excluding this case, the number of processed accounts has decreased by 16.8% since the second half of 2020.
The number of accounts processed in response to requests based on search and seizure warrants for Daum services (8,088 accounts) is not significantly different from that of the first half of 2020 (7,742 account). In the second half of 2020, there was a notable increase temporarily due to a request related to a specific case of law violation.
